title: SharePoint Embedded: container type creation and billing split across two PowerShell cmdlets
summary: The two-step creation and billing process and the roadmap details are supported. Hold for incomplete billing permission requirements: the cmdlet reference requires active time-bound billing permission, and both container type owners and consuming-tenant billing administrators also need Azure subscription access.

claims.claim: The roadmap separates container type creation from adding its billing profile.
claims.quote: The New-SPOContainerType cmdlet will only create a new container type. We are introducing the Add-SPOContainerTypeBilling cmdlet to add billing profile to the new container type.

claims.claim: The -TrialContainerType switch creates a trial container type valid for 30 days.
claims.quote: In Example 3, the cmdlet creates a trial container type, ContosoLegal, valid for 30 days.
